entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. A VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. I can see you've had it for about 18 days now. To make sure I'm processing this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Look, it's been a long couple of weeks. There was a family emergency.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I just need to understand the reason for the return request.

My husband was scheduled for an unexpected military deployment, and right before he was supposed to leave, my father had a fall. It required immediate surgery, and we've all been at the hospital. I haven't even had a moment to think about this sensor.
That sounds incredibly stressful, I appreciate you sharing that. Let me just double-check the policy for you here... one moment.
Okay, I've got it. Actually, you have nothing to worry about. The delivery was only 18 days ago, and our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery.
So all that explaining was for nothing. Fine.

My apologies for the extra questions. I just wanted to be thorough. Since you're well within the 90-day window, I can go ahead and process this return for you right now. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Whatever. As long as it's done. So I get a full refund?
Yes, absolutely. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get better for you and your family.
